item.mimic.mimic_invitation.tip_2: [Use outside to travel to the Lethean Sea; use within to summon The Mimic]
item.mimic.proteus_commendation.tip_2: [Using it in the Lethean Sea returns you to the spawn point; using it outside summons a phantom that recorded this battle to assist in combat]
item.mimic.proteus_commendation.tip_3: [The phantom will attack targets locked by the player]
item.mimic.proteus_commendation.tip_4: [Phantoms that have lost Proteus's dominion can no longer mimic new attacks]
mod.mimic.tip_2: As if I'd let myself be tainted by that scrap of yours.
mod.mimic.tip_3: What a truly disappointing excuse for a weapon.
